$schema: Calmido store listing copy — source of truth for the App Store and Google Play listings, across every language. App strings are NOT here: they live in each app's own catalogue (calmido-phone-ios Localizable.xcstrings, calmido-phone-android strings.xml). See $scope below.

$scope.included: Everything a store console asks you to type: names, subtitles, descriptions, keywords, release notes, and the URLs the listing points at.
$scope.excluded: In-app strings. Of 267 iOS strings, 163 are byte-identical to an Android one — but 105 of those are under 20 characters ('Cancel', 'Next', 'Skip') and only 3 are prose. Unifying them would cost key remapping, format-specifier differences (%@ vs %1$s) and plural handling, to avoid translating 'Annuleren' twice. Not worth it.
$scope.alsoExcluded: Screenshots, feature graphics and icons. Different problem — tracked separately.

$status: SEEDED, NOT COMPLETE. null means 'not written yet'. The Play values must be exported from the Play Console first — Android is live at 3.1.1, so its listing already exists there and is the better starting point than a blank page. Run scripts/check-store-listing.mjs to see what is still missing or over limit.
$notEnforced: There is deliberately no CI check yet. This file is a central place to keep the copy, not a build input. Wiring it into the app repos, and failing builds on drift, is a later decision.

$limits.comment: Character limits per store. Verify against the live consoles before a submission — Apple and Google both move these.

$locales.comment: Benelux test launch: Netherlands, Belgium, Luxembourg. Belgium is ~40% French-speaking and French is Luxembourg's administrative language, so fr is not optional. German is deliberately out, matching calmido-website's VALID_LOCALES — revisit if Luxembourg demands it.

$urls.comment: Locale-prefixed website routes. The fr listing points at be-fr rather than lu-fr because Belgium is the larger French-speaking market of the two — confirm that is the intent.

appStore.$comment: iOS — App Store Connect. Apple ID 6759002138, bundle com.calmido.phone. Keywords are an Apple-only field and are NOT translations: what a Dutch or French user types to find a call blocker is not the English terms rendered into their language.

play.$comment: Android — Google Play. Live at versionName 3.1.1, so these values exist in the Play Console today and should be exported rather than rewritten. Play has no keywords field: the full description carries discovery weight instead, which is why the two stores cannot share one body of text verbatim.
